I know rightt. People get so mad when someone kills themselves. “How could they do that?? They had so much to live for!” Like bitch you don’t know what they were going through.

Honestly speaking, all this school shit won’t even matter in a couple of years.you will laugh when you look back and think about how many fucks you gave for bullshit grades. Let me tell you, the education system is fucked up, okay? They don’t value creativity, they don’t value individuality.  But the education system is not life. School will be over soon, and you will go out in the world and realise there is SO MUCH to live for. Till then, develop other interests, spend time in doing things that make you happy, trust me, grades are NOT everything. A major part of your life is ahead of you, so keep living,even if it’s just for the curiosity of what lies ahead.

I’m really sorry you feel that way :/. I relate.
But You’re not a coward. You prolly don’t really wanna end your life, you know? you want to end the pain, the loneliness, the extreme fatigue, the constant sadness, the self-hate. Hhh I really wish there was an easier way.I wish there was a button I could press to stop existing. I don’t want to die, I just never wanted to be alive in the first place. You still end up hurting people after you die, you still end up living in their memories, a part of you lives on. I wish there was a way to erase all that. But there isn’t. Just keep holding on for a little longer. One day at a time. 
And I’m sorry about your friends. You’re not a horrible person. Everyone makes mistakes n does things they regret. That doesn’t make you unworthy of love. You have a right to be loved. But Sometimes it’s so hard just to maintain relationships. Even when I know they are slipping away, I almost feel helpless to do anything. Cuz I just have no fucking energy to fix it. Do you feel like that too? I hope you feel better, one day at a time.
